Thanks for taking this on. HealthCo's compliance team submitted a SIG Lite intake and they need a compact access-control bundle to close their onboarding review. Can you provide the following within the next 5 business days?

Hi Alex,

Thanks for the request — attaching the access-control pack for HealthCo below. Files attached and links provided for your convenience: 

Attachments included (redacted as noted):
- saml-assertions-samples.txt — two assertion snippets (NameID and attribute sets); PII placeholders used for non-admin subjects.
- scim-sync-snapshot.csv — full sync snapshot with source and timestamp columns.
- scim-90d-activity.csv — 90-day delta export.
- rbac-owner-matrix.xlsx — role -> privilege -> owner mapping; "unowned" roles are highlighted.
- log-redaction-readme.md — short doc listing redactions and how to request fuller exports.

Short posture note (for SIG Lite):
- SSO: We emit standard SAML attributes and canonical NameID; assertions are signed and validated via idp-initiated and sp-initiated flows.
- Provisioning: SCIM syncs run on a scheduled cadence (primary source: customer IdP). Deltas are audited; we store sync metadata (source, timestamp, change type).
- RBAC & least privilege: Roles are scoped per-tenant; admin privileges require explicit owner assignment and audit logging. Service accounts exist for infra tasks and are rotated per policy; any unowned service accounts are flagged for owner assignment.

If you need an unredacted audit package for SOC/SIG full review, we can create a secure delivery and coordinate legal/L3 sign-off. For SIG Lite this package should satisfy the intake — please confirm receipt and whether anything else is required.

Best,
Irene
